findings.summary: The MapGetResult specialization for std::shared_ptr was dead once every record became bbl::js::Ref; deleted it, with the Ref members no generated code reaches (nullptr forms, use_count).

The voxel save writer spelled numbers through iostream setprecision, a second formatter beside format_number; it now builds the document with concat/NumberPart, the one spelling every coercion shares.

The voxel save/load boundary pulled <filesystem>, <fstream> and the PAL header into the plain-data header every scene includes; moved it to js_voxel_file.hpp, included only by a scene that reaches it.

The lookup cache of Map/Set was reset at three mutation sites and recorded a writer's own miss only to discard it; one invalidate_lookup owns the pair and Map::set/Set::add look up without remembering.

is_ascii_whitespace duplicated the predicate string_trim and number_from_string already spelled inline; all three read one helper. The two bitwise lanes' to_uint32 overloads and the three concat text overloads collapsed to one each; the redundant zero branch in format_number was deleted.

pal.cpp re-implemented UTF-8/UTF-16 conversion beside pal_system_fonts.cpp's copy and re-derived the pointer-lock release sync_pointer_lock owns; both now share pal_win32_text.hpp and the one lock transition, and the non-Windows picker refuses by name instead of writing beside the executable behind no dialog.

The comparison lowering stripped a bound local's static number at the call site while castNumber kept folding it for every other caller; the binding rule (parameterBinding or nativeBinding) now lives in castNumber, every emitted local carries nativeBinding, and the comparison calls castNumber plainly. This also fixed the unread-local warnings-as-errors the PR's fold left in tetris and the tuple-unroll test.

Number-to-text coercion was spelled in compileTemplate, stringConcatPart and String(x); the template literal and String(x) now route through stringConcatPart (enum arm included), and the two UI cssText/innerHTML builders emit the same one-buffer bbl::js::concat.

A compile-time record read under a run-time key materialized its whole table as a function-local static at every reading function (five copies of the 23-entry block registry); one native accessor per table now serves every read.

Object.keys and Object.values were parallel forty-line arms; one projection serves both. probeEmission's four identical predicates became its default. The keyboard event's repeat arm joined the modifier table.
The optional-chain reference-struct arm rewrote C++ text with replaceAll to bind its owner once; it binds through leafValue's own presence and identity spellings instead.
Class parameter binding walked the whole body once per parameter looking for spread uses; one walk per declaration, cached.

packagedImageBitmapSuccessPath re-typed retainedCanvasFactorySuccessPath's try/catch-null shape test; both consume one nullFallbackTryShape helper. moduleHasObservedMutableState re-walked the statements moduleVariableSymbols already walked; the latter takes a subset argument.

The uniform component-count ladder was spelled four times and the WGSL uniform alignment table restated the capture decoder's layoutOf; shader-ir exports the one component table, the two shader-material ladders and the renderer lowerer read it, and alignment comes from layoutOf/roundUp.

shader-material's staticNumber duplicated expectStaticNumber; the latter is now the failing wrapper of the former. cli.ts and adaptations.ts re-typed the executed-asset source prefixes executed-module-assets exports; they import the constants. The fetched-atlas bake re-typed the harness's base64 encoder; it uses pageBase64Script.
The SDL_GPU upload batch value-initialized its staging bytes before copying into them (a third pass over every staged megabyte); the staging buffer grows without initialization.

The shader-geometry reuse cache kept a CPU copy of every cached geometry to compare against, hundreds of megabytes for a streaming voxel world; it identifies a geometry by counts plus a content hash on both backends and keeps bytes only below a few thousand vertices, where sharing happens and the hash is confirmed byte for byte.

removeFromScene never reclaimed a retired mesh's CPU geometry, so streaming grew engine.geometries without bound; the removal frees geometry no other mesh shares, and re-adding such a mesh refuses by name.
compileVoxelFileCall resolved every identifier call's declaration before testing the two names; the name test runs first.

TODO entries this branch closed were still open (class setters, createTexture2DFromPixels srgb, ShaderMaterial blendMode) and the probe entry did not record the shipped half; updated, and the app-keyed voxel file boundary is filed with its unblocker.

The voxel save/load boundary is detected by module path and function name and restates the pin's JSON.stringify key order as a hand-typed grammar in the runtime -- an app-keyed branch in two generic layers.
findings.blockedBy: A capability that does not exist: lowering JSON.stringify/JSON.parse over a plain-data record (the runtime's JsonValue reads documents and nlohmann is linked only under the glTF/.babylon loaders). With it, only the showSaveFilePicker/showOpenFilePicker calls remain a PAL seam recognised by the browser API they reach.

findings.summary: Per-face allocations in the voxel mesher (the corners, light and UV lists a face builds) are ~14 heap allocations per face even after the small-array growth fix; lowering a non-escaping local array literal to fixed storage needs an escape check the compiler does not have.
findings.blockedBy: A capability that does not exist: escape analysis over plain-data locals (no store into a record field, no return, no capture) that would let a local array literal lower to std::array.

findings.summary: The fetched-atlas bake is reached by sniffing the module text for createImageBitmap/drawImage/getImageData and hard-codes the sibling blocks.ts module, the buildBlockAtlas export and the voxelpack directory; the drawn-sprite-atlas bake executes a zero-argument export keyed by an asset prefix and knows none of that.
findings.blockedBy: A capability that does not exist: handing the executed-export bake driver an entry call with statically known arguments and a served asset set, so a fetched-image canvas bake needs no knowledge of the module's neighbours.

findings.summary: The crosshair rule is spelled in the compiler (a regex over the exact 2px/22px gradient) and the PAL (the same sizes restated in append_crosshair).
findings.blockedBy: A measurement nobody has taken: no second reached HUD draws a layered-gradient crosshair, so the general lowering (a positioned child per background layer) has nothing to measure against; the two spellings are pinned by the voxel gate meanwhile.

findings.summary: The tuple Array.map arm in data-methods.ts and compileStaticTupleCallback in expressions.ts are two tuple-callback lowerings with different parameter support and index spellings; the map-iterator next arm re-spells guardableElementRead's guarded read; bindParameters keeps three value sources.
findings.blockedBy: Merging the two tuple-callback lowerings changes which callback shapes each accepts (array-binding patterns versus plain identifiers) and the index literal width, which needs the tuple-map scenes re-measured; the guarded-read reuse needs a synthesized ElementAccessExpression the lowerer does not yet build.
